title: Endpoints of the two finite coefficient routes
statement: For supplied UniformizerSquareData q [def-diagonal-uniformizer-root-frame], define residueMap to be cartierResidueAlgebra with the cyclic frame coefficient type diagonalResidue retained, and restriction to be ordinary scalar restriction along this map. sourceMap and lineMap are the supplied maps with their restricted direct-image and line targets retained explicitly. Define cyclicFunctor as cyclic derived extension followed by the supplied cyclic finite realization, and quotientFunctor as successive integral and quotient derived extension followed by the supplied A-realization. The initial objects are the single supported Z_l unit and the degree-two shifted single Z_l line. initialSource and initialTarget extract the domain and codomain of the supplied arrow, retaining its coefficient category without rebuilding it. The functors and endpoints are fields of the explicit FiniteRouteData bundles [def-diagonal-coefficient-route-data], so their types are shared without reconstructing large derived-functor expressions. The bundles contain a proved universal realization calculation, constructed before an arrow is supplied. cyclicSource and quotientSource compose the supplied supported endpoints with the exact single comparison and the ordinary supported-source isomorphism. cyclicTarget and quotientTarget compose the supplied shifted line endpoints with exact single/shift comparisons and the ordinary line endpoint isomorphism. ScalarCompatibility.compositeSource and compositeTarget provide the composite supported-source and shifted line endpoints before realization. These are explicit constructions; they assert no naturality or class equation.
